author: Clijmart
body:
After lots of talking and thinking, I decided to change these 4 maps of mine.
I added / changed everything I got suggested :)
I'd like to learn some XML, so I can help with setting up the maps. Anyone available?

Biggest changes:
- Removed most diamonds / enchanted items to reduce killfarming.
- Removed rods in SquaredNature.
- Changed some of the island shapes in most maps.

YinYang: http://www.mediafire.com/file/jajs62f24bun9ei/YinYang_%5BDTM%5D.rar
SquaredNature: http://www.mediafire.com/file/s5z0ed4j1w5b1bm/SquaredNature_%5BDTM%5D.rar
Ponylands: http://www.mediafire.com/file/4embgndzcfevv5g/PonyLands_%5BDTM%5D.rar
Towers: http://www.mediafire.com/file/57qbt16lebb1ya7/Towers_%5BTDM%5D.rar

Please tell me if I need to change anything else, or if there's any bugs. <3

Editing Waves, Darkness and Portals soon...

Thanks,
Clijmart
